hardware: JAXA Multiple Artificial-gravity Research System (MARS), ISS Kibo Centrifuge-equipped Biological Experiment Facility (CBEF/CBEF-L)

schema.Date: Published timestamp string; no timezone stated in raw export
schema.RPM: Measured centrifuge rotational speed, revolutions per minute

recommended_initial_comparison.external_test: MHU-2, same published 0.15 m/77 rpm configuration
recommended_initial_comparison.target: Observed one-step measured RPM forecast, or explicitly declared longer-horizon forecast
recommended_initial_comparison.scope: Flight hardware RPM telemetry forecasting. Does not identify free-flying habitat control dynamics or performance under new commanded torque.

preprocessing_notes: Do not treat each row as uniformly sampled; check timestamp differences.
MHU-1 and MHU-2 have duplicate timestamps; choose and document aggregation or causal record selection.
Some midnight dates omit time; treat date-only entries as 00:00:00, preserving timezone-unspecified status.
Do not fill missing MHU-4 RPM with zeros; gaps are missing measurements.
Do not window across gaps or missions.
Zero RPM is real stopped hardware, according to Supplementary Figure 1 cage maintenance caption.
Steady operation dominates the logs; include persistence baseline and separate startup/stop and steady-operation metrics.
Only four mission histories are present; millions of autocorrelated rows are not independent experiments.

missions.source_discrepancy: Official ibSLS overview says 32 rpm, earlier 2023/2024 mission papers say 31 rpm; raw measured mean for selected interval is 32.4 rpm. Preserve distinctions between nominal and measured values.

missions.use_radius_caution: Do not silently resolve radius discrepancy. It is irrelevant to RPM-only prediction but material to derived centrifugal acceleration.
